## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: feature_registry overlap analysis reports two registered features touching...

The system SHALL ensure that feature_registry overlap analysis reports two registered features touching the same requirement or contract file as a collision at the matching level.

#### Scenario: feature_registry overlap analysis reports two registered features touching...

WHEN `coordinator-contract-overlap` is implemented
THEN feature_registry overlap analysis reports two registered features touching the same requirement or contract file as a collision at the matching level.

### Requirement: With the coordinator reachable, /plan-feature's collision report includes...

The system SHALL ensure that with the coordinator reachable, /plan-feature's collision report includes live claims not yet visible on the git remote, labeled as such.

#### Scenario: With the coordinator reachable, /plan-feature's collision report includes...

WHEN `coordinator-contract-overlap` is implemented
THEN With the coordinator reachable, /plan-feature's collision report includes live claims not yet visible on the git remote, labeled as such.

### Requirement: With the coordinator unreachable, the collision report is identical to the...

The system SHALL ensure that with the coordinator unreachable, the collision report is identical to the git-native report and planning is not blocked.

#### Scenario: With the coordinator unreachable, the collision report is identical to the...

WHEN `coordinator-contract-overlap` is implemented
THEN With the coordinator unreachable, the collision report is identical to the git-native report and planning is not blocked.
